tools.name: get_token_prices
tools.description: Fetch ERC-20 token prices with multi-range history. Sort by 30m, 1h, 24h, 7d, or 30d price change to find gainers/losers. Returns price, market cap, volume, and change % across all time ranges.

tools.name: get_tokens
tools.description: Query the E3D token database. Returns token metadata: name, symbol, address, market cap, liquidity, and fraud risk score.

params.name: search
params.description: Search by name, symbol, or address

tools.name: get_transactions
tools.description: Fetch recent Ethereum transactions indexed by E3D. Optionally filter by token address, wallet address, or text search.

tools.name: get_address_meta
tools.description: Get identity and metadata for an Ethereum address (token or wallet). Returns labels, tags, entity name, and known associations.

tools.name: get_token_info
tools.description: Get detailed token profile: supply, holders, contract info, social links, price history, and E3D-computed risk/quality scores.

tools.name: get_token_info_json
tools.description: Get rich token info JSON including on-chain data, price history, holders, contract metadata, social links, and E3D-computed scores.

tools.name: get_agent_candidates
tools.description: Get E3D agent's top-scored token candidates — tokens with converging on-chain signals across multiple story types. Fields include convergence_score, signal_count, story_types, direction_hint, signal_summary, thesis_conviction, entry/invalidation signals, price targets, fraud_risk, liquidity_quality.

params.name: status
params.description: Comma-separated status filter: new, promoted, dismissed

tools.name: get_theses
tools.description: Get structured investment theses generated by the E3D agent. Each thesis includes: direction (long/short), conviction score, thesis text, entry/invalidation signals, price targets, fraud_risk, liquidity_quality, slippage estimate, and time horizon.

params.name: status
params.description: Status filter: active | confirmed | all (or comma-separated)

tools.name: get_token_counterparties
tools.description: Get the most frequent counterparty wallets for a token — who is trading with whom.

tools.name: get_address_counterparties
tools.description: Get counterparty analysis for a wallet address — wallets it most frequently interacts with.

tools.name: search_stories
tools.description: Search E3D on-chain stories by keyword, token symbol, or address. Stories are LLM-generated narratives derived from transaction graph patterns.

params.name: q
params.description: Search query: address, symbol, or keywords

tools.name: get_agents
tools.description: List E3D AI agents. Each ERC-20 token can have an activated AI agent. Returns agent status (running/dormant/hibernating/failed), E3D balance, and metadata.

tools.name: get_agent
tools.description: Get full details for a specific AI agent by token address. Includes status, E3D treasury balance, soul IPFS hash, focus areas, goals, and heartbeat timestamp.

tools.name: get_agent_stats
tools.description: Get aggregate statistics for all E3D agents: counts by status.

tools.name: get_agent_artifacts
tools.description: Get artifacts produced by an agent: analyses, reports, strategies, and other outputs.

tools.name: get_agent_next_action
tools.description: Get the agent's current next-best-action recommendation: what it plans to do next, why now, estimated E3D burn, confidence score, and any blockers.

tools.name: get_agent_funding
tools.description: Get funding history and treasury stats for an agent: total funded, total burned, daily/weekly burn rate, and escrow contract info.

tools.name: get_agent_burns
tools.description: Get E3D token burn history for an agent along with burn statistics (daily/weekly totals).

tools.name: get_agent_value_events
tools.description: Get value-creation events logged by an agent — moments where the agent generated measurable value (in E3D) and the reason.

tools.name: get_agent_executions
tools.description: Get execution history for an agent: each run with status, start/end timestamps, E3D burned per execution, and result codes.

tools.name: get_agent_strategies
tools.description: Get configured strategies for an agent: which strategy types are enabled, approval mode (auto vs proposal-only), burn caps, risk level, and config.

tools.name: get_agent_budget_policy
tools.description: Get the budget and treasury policy for an agent: daily/weekly burn caps, minimum balance thresholds, hibernate trigger, and current treasury state.
